instruction:
Storefront Retrofit IFC And Revit Elevation Sheet PDF

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a storefront scheme, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a one-page Revit elevation sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 1 IfcSpace, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcDoor entity, and 4 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name retail space.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
8. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens STOREFRONT ELEVATION and Main street facade.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
